video_title: Kindness is My Superpower | Read Aloud by Reading Pioneers Academy
description:
I am so grateful to be reading, "Kindness is My Superpower" by Alicia Ortego who allowed me to read her book on my channel. Little Lucas will learn what kindness means and have more understanding for others, accept differences, and show more empathy. This is a must-read for children to see how super you can become with simple acts of kindness.
